notes.title: 1.2.2 Sports & Research
notes.notes:
SPORTS CHANGE
Sports has been reworked. They no longer reduce by 1 at the end of turn but instead are completely removed at the end of each wave
This should make it easier for small practice to be able to make an impact towards the second half of each wave but make it harder to keep maxed out. 

Some sports Tokens have been tweaked based on this change
Puck changed from: Practice Hockey twice -> Practice Hockey once

Skiier changed from: After 5 Levels of Tokens have been Exhausted -> After 7 Levels of Tokens have been Exhausted
Goal changed from: Countdown 5 -> Countdown 6
Upgraded versions of these tokens have also been nerfed to only Practice sports once instead of twice

Sports Research Level 3 Discovery has changed from: Your Sports no longer reduce at the end of the turn -> Your Sports reduce by half at the end of the wave instead of being removed

OTHER RESEARCH CHANGES
Creativity Research Level 3 Discovery has changed from: At the end of the Turn your Queued Token 3 Times -> Whenever you Buff your Queued Token Create it

Science Research Level 3 Discovery has changed from: Whenever an infected Enemy dies it spreads its infection Twice as much -> Whenever you Infect an enemy Attack it for the same amount

Fruit Research Level 3 Discovery Fruit Tree has been buffed from: Passive: At the end of the turn Create one of each Fruit -> Passive: At the end of the turn Create one of each Fruit, Feed any that don't fit to your queued token

SEEDED RUNS
The seed of a run is now shown at the end of the run. 
You can paste seeds now when you go to play a game, however runs with seeds will not count towards winstreaks

TOKEN CHANGES
Crypto Coin changed from: Appear: Attack 3, if this kills an enemy reduce by 1. Whenever this attacks for 0 -> Appear: Attack 0. When you get an Upgraded Token from the Market Upgrade this
Crypto Coin Upgraded changed from Appear: Attack 6, if this kills an enemy reduce by 1. Whenever this attacks for 0 -> Appear: Attack 4. When you get an Upgraded Token from the Market Reset this to an un-upgraded Crypto Coin.
Ogre Mask: The Enchantments now fade away at the end of each turn
Telephone changed from: Appear: Attack 1 to all enemies if there are less than 4 enemies -> Appear: Attack 1 to all Enemies if there are 4 enemies

QOL CHANGES
When you use the random board feature it will now show you the board picked and it's ability at the start of the run

The "End Turn Now" button appears based on time now instead of triggers and will always appear after 10s of animations.

ENEMY CHANGES
Lady bugs cannot "normally" spawn more than 4 in a single wave
Eternity has now been fixed to always go to the back of the line of enemies. This is most impactful on endless when new enemies can keep spawning

TRANSFER CODE LIGHTER
The transfer code has been shortened to only include very important data stats to transfer between devices. It now ONLY includes what is unlocked and your BEST winstreaks on each of them, will not transfer highscores, current winstreaks or furthest wave. This is to ensure that the code is as small as possible as to be able to transfer on most copy paste bins.

CHALLENGE CHANGES
Bees have been blacklisted from Feast Or Famine
Ninja has been blacklisted from Even Steven

BUG FIXES
Tennis no longer continues to multiply attack on multistrike or multiple triggered attacks
Bus and Angel no longer cause a crash
Most of the other bugs listed in the Discord

notes.title: 1.2.1 Buffed Friends & Nerfed Enemy Friends
notes.notes:
BALANCE CHANGES
Film Camera now Creates the Queued Token if it is already a Tape (instead of doing nothing)
Converted Bee damage 4 -> 3 Attack. Upgraded Bee no longer has multistrike but has 6 Attack instead
Converted Evil Monkey now only Buffs and Triggers adjacent Attack Tokens
Teal Board can no longer turn your Spawnable into a Wine or wine based Dish (Cos wine is special and nothing actually spawns it but you know, was also busted to get on Wave 1)
Teal Board now also cannot transform a Spawnable into the same spawnable
Mammoth: Passive: At the end of the turn Create a random Ingredient. Whenever a Token consumes a Dish Trigger it -> Passive: At the end of the turn Create a random Ingredient. Whenever a Token with an Attack consumes a Dish, Trigger it.

EVOLUTION CHANGES
Construction Site no longer adds vests to "Final" Enemies

BUG FIXES
Piranha text now correctly states that you take Damage when it is Destroyed
Mad Difficulty no longer gives you a random evolution at the start
Fixed bug where you could drag Powers to the board

notes.title: 1.2.0 The Enemy of my Enemy is my friend
notes.notes:
[h2]NEW DIFFICULTIES[/h2]
Blushing Difficulty has been added as a step between Chill and Worried
Existential is now the new hardest difficulty

[h2]CONVERTED ENEMIES[/h2]
There are now Converted Enemy Tokens for all the new Enemies, that's 22 New Tokens added to the game with effects based off the enemy their based off.
Puffer Fish: Destroyed: Infect a random Enemy by 30 -> Destroyed: Trigger an Enemy Infection then  Infect a random Enemy by 15
T-Rex Damage: 32 -> 16
Ant: Appear: Attack 1 (+1 for each Ant on the board) and Create an Ant-> Appear: Attack 2 and Create an Exhausted Ant
Scorpion: Destroyed: Buff all your Tokens by 5 -> Destroyed: Improve adjacent Tokens by 5

[h2]ENEMY CHANGES[/h2]
Piranha Razor change: At the end of the turn Attack and remove this Ability -> At the end of the turn Attack and remove all Razors across all Enemies

[h2]NEW BOARD[/h2]
New Board as a reward for beating Existential. It's pretty hard to beat existential.

[h2]CHALLENGES[/h2]
Disguised now has all enemies in it

[h2]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Performance has been improved for when attacking with tokens with large multistrike
Performance has been improved for when crafting large amounts of craft

[h2]TOKEN BALANCE CHANGES AND REWORK[/h2]
Mammoth Rework: Passive: At the end of the turn Play an Ingredient onto a random consumable on the board -> Passive: Whenever a Token consumes a Dish Trigger it. At the end of the turn Create a random Ingredient
Goal: Countdown 4 -> Countdown 5

[h2]PATCH NOTES VIEWER[/h2]
If you press the Version number in menu you can see the past few patch notes

[h2]STATS[/h2]
When you hover or press the Eye it will also show stats like:
All tokens Destroyed
Unique Consumables Consumed
Strawberry buff value (if its been buffed)
Skeleton buff value (if its been buffed)
If the next Market is Upgraded from compass
The Buff on the Future Market

[h2]TAP HINTS[/h2]
You can cycle through the hints on the menu just by tapping it

[h2]BOARD CHANGES[/h2]
Black Board has been changed from \"Your rerolls cost health but you heal 2 at the end of each wave\" to \"You can use health to re-roll when you are out of rerolls\"
Purple Board has been changed from \"At the start of the game Research 5 into a random Science\" to \"Whenever you get a Token from the Market Research it by 1, 2 if it is Upgraded\"

[h2]DISH CHANGES[/h2]
Nearly half of the dishes have been buffed or reworked and improved. Too many to list here

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
Fixed UI issues that caused overlay of keyword text while in the deck viewer
Fixed issue of Enemies doing wiggle even when they aren't doing anything
Fixed issue with bubble tea not triggering appear before destroying token
Many token bug fixes

Candyland Fixed to not effect  the final boss

Big bad Boss fixed

Crane now can destroy level 9's
Supervillain will no longer destroy Devil
Log button can now be pressed in end game screen

[h2]Clarity Changes:[/h2]
(wherever it is) now swapped out for the everywhere keyword to be more clear

But who here cares about that am I right?

notes.title: 1.1.3 Enemy Rebalances 2.0 and some more Tweaks

[h2]Enemy Rebalances[/h2]
Bee now only does 1 attack if perfectly killed
Wraith goes to the 5 health slot so comes in earlier
Cockroach goes to the 8 health slot so comes in later
Troll only activates once then loses it's ability
Ladybug is now restricted to only spawn once in a group

[h2]Random Board[/h2]
You can now choose Random on your board selection to get a random board

[h2]Challenge Update[/h2]
Ticking Time Bomb no longer triggers on Tokens that Appear because you changed a Token from the Market

[h2]Token and Power Changes[/h2]
Creativity Discovery 3 goes from: Whenever you Merge a Token Create your Queued Token -> At the end of the Turn Create your Queued Token 3 Times
Ant now does 2 damage flat instead of scaling with amount of Ants on the board

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Ogre Mask now removes its Marks when it runs away after an attack
Fire does not get doubled up by Confetti anymore
End of Turn Countdowns now trigger correctly from top left to bottom right
Fixed bug with Bow not triggering after awoken
Fixed bug with Infect not hitting Alienoid
Whale is now fixed so repeats all Creates
Trident no longer goes to your queued token when consumed
Cloud save now carries along the correct current winstreak

notes.title: 1.1.2 Hotfix
notes.notes: Hotfix to fix a couple minor bugs but most importantly a bug that was sometimes stopping the tutorial from working properly

notes.title: 1.1.2 - Enemy Shuffle
notes.notes:
[h2]Toggle Eyes:[/h2][p]You can now click the eyes to keep it toggled on to see the numbers

[/p][h2]Enemy Changes:[/h2][p]Bee effect now does 2 damage if you kill it perfectly but has changed to be on the 5 health slot so comes later in the run instead
Beetle has now gone down to the 3 Health slot and ability has changed from gain 3 health to gain 2 health at the end of every turn
Piranha has gone down to 1 health but remains as a replacement for lizard
Locusts now cannot exhaust Spawned Tokens (or any level 0 Token)
Feast or Famine blacklists piranhas

[/p][h2]Evolution Changes[/h2][p]Swarm has gone from Every 3rd enemy that spawns gains an extra Fly to Every 4th enemy that spawns gains an extra 2 Fly. Swarm no longer counts spawned Flys towards the Swarm Counter

[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Fixed Near Death not functioning properly
Fixed Bug that allowed you to gain an extra reroll when loading a game from the first market


[/p][h2]Balance changes from last update I forgot to mention[/h2][p]Turkey: Has gone from 3 to 4 attack base [/p][p]Water Cup: Awake an adjacent Token to Destroy self -> Awake an adjacent Token to Level Up  [/p]

[h2]Enemy Balance Changes[/h2]
Troll: Now Levels down the highest Token by 1 instead of by 2
Bee, Piranha and LadyBug are now blacklisted from the Near Death Challenge
Super Serum has been reworked. Previously it gave certain enemies Triple their effect. Now instead it gives them a random Health Buffing Enemy Ability instead

[h2]Auto Speed up[/h2]
The game now automatically speeds up if you've been stuck in an action for too long. Additionally at the 2 highest speeds the screen shake automatically turns off now

[h2]General Balance Changes[/h2]
Tanghulu: Your kiwifruit level up Tokens after triggering them -> Your kiwifruit and grapes level up Tokens after triggering them
Tanghulu+: Your kiwifruit and grapes Level up Tokens after triggering them -> Your kiwifruit and grapes Level up Tokens twice after triggering them

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Fixed typos in Ticking Time challenge
Fixed Masquerade typo

notes.title: Enemies Update
notes.notes: [h2]Lots of new Enemies[/h2][p]Once you've beaten Worried, every 3 runs a new Enemy will be added to the pool of enemies to pick from. 22 new enemies, including 2 new enemies at every level and 4 new bosses (depending on your difficulty) These enemies shake up builds, target certain weaknesses, and even pack on some aggression in the early game.[/p][p]There's a new "Show Enemies" button in the market. Make sure you click it and hover over the enemies in your run so you can plan your build accordingly.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Collection Book[/h2][p]Your collection has been turned into a collection book.[/p][p]Now you can see the last 10 games you played, wins or losses.[/p][p]Your total wins, furthest wave you've gotten to, each of your medals.[/p][p]You can also see the Enemies you have encountered or discovered in your games.[/p][p][/p][h2]UI Update - Hovering is now a thing[/h2][p]Hovering! Now the market shows keyword definitions when you hover over them instead of clicking them.[/p][p]Also you can hover over cards in your deck view to see the same keywords you would in the market[/p][p]ALSO you can hover over enemies in the wave info page to see what their base abilities are[/p][p][/p][h2]Challenge Updates[/h2][p]Disguised has changed so the converted enemies have Levels attached to them.[/p][p]Ticking Time challenge has changed so the Bomb's countdown is 8 but only does 1 damage to you instead of killing you[/p][p][/p][h2]Board Changes[/h2][p]Red Board now only works once per turn[/p][p]Brown Board now gives you 2 extra rerolls as well as the random Tokens[/p][p][/p][h2]Token and Power Changes[/h2][p]Robotic arm has gone to a Level 2 Token (sorry all your robotic arm abusers)[/p][p]Crypto Coin has gone to a Level 1 Token[/p][p]Doctor has gone to +2 Attack for every infected Enemy[/p][p]Mirage has gone to triggering the Merge effect of all tokens in your set Twice[/p][p]Jigsaw has gone to +3 attack[/p][p]Wrench has gone to +4 attack[/p][p]Strawberry now starts at +2 Attack[/p][p]Chips now starts at +5 Attack[/p][p][/p][h2]Event Cap Removed[/h2][p]The event cap has been removed[/p][p]As a bandage fix to loops a button will now appear when a certain amount of triggers have happened in an action allowing you to end the effects early[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Orangutan is now spelt correctly (facepalm)[/p][p]Speedster achievement has been fixed[/p][p]Enemies now go to NaN health once they exceed the limit[/p][p]The Fly evolution now works correctly[/p][p]Numerous other less important bug fixes[/p][p][/p]

notes.notes:
Ahoy, tried to fix up all the reported bugs before I go on away for a week work trip.

[h2]MacOS Fixes[/h2]
Fixed issues with MacOS not connecting to Steam properly.
Achievements and Cloud save should now work

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Lots of bug fixes. Managed to get through most of the bugs reported up until today *Fingers Crossed*

notes.title: 1.0.17 - Scales and Sight
notes.notes:
[h2]Game End Board Shower[/h2]
On the end game stats screen you can now press "Show Board" if you want to have a look at your final board

[h2]UI Enlarged[/h2]
The cards in the market and in your deck have been enlarged by a small amount. Still looking for better ways to show the card text better for people playing on smaller devices but this should help at least a little bit

[h2]Steam connection update[/h2]
Updated the Steam connection which may help with stability issues connecting to Steam Achievements and cloud saves for users that had issues with it. If you are still having issues please say hi in the discord 

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Coral now copies Juicebox with the Countdown of the token
Upgraded Strawberry Pie now goes off before your badgers attack, allowing it to feed them for you
Contractor now waits for factory to create it's level 1's
Fixed some Mirage bugs, but can't guarantee they're all gone.

notes.title: 1.0.16 Fan Fixes and Settings
notes.notes:
[h2]Better settings[/h2]
Background toggle, to turn on or off the scrolling background
Game now remembers the window size of the game in windowed mode

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Lots of bug fixes when passive tokens that don't have attack are triggered with universal triggerers
Fixed bugs with certain challenges causing the game to brick
Fixed bug with Teapot going invisible
Fixed zombie not attacking if it can't destroy something
Fixed upgraded comet leveling up twice
Added more infinite loop triggering protection
Fixed camp not triggering

[h2]Text Updates[/h2]
Updated text of Tokens that can't interact with themselves to explicitly say non-X tokens
Tiger now says that it increases the buff value of strawberries PERMANENTLY

notes.title: 1.0.15 Bug Exterminating
notes.notes:
[h2]Text Improvements[/h2]
Changed 51 instances of it's to the correct possessive its. Sorry to everyone I've caused trauma with from this. 
Your is now defined to for MiniMart to specify your tokens not including anything created by enemy effects
Consume:, consumes and Consume better represent what they do in their keywords (in all the different ways that one can consume)
Couch now shows the damage on the token it has increased the damage for

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Lots of bug fixes, tried addressing almost all bugs people have encountered in the last couple days. I imagine there still will be more but I am proactively on bug hunts now too.

notes.title: 1.0.14 - Board Balance and UI
notes.notes: [h2]UI highlighter[/h2][p]Added a UI highlighter, now when you press a token it shows you what you can merge with. Mostly there for new people to help show when you can merge with the Queue token, when you can merge with other tokens, etc... Honestly when I first put it in I found it annoying cos I already know what to merge but after a run I started finding it satisfying so I hope you guys do too.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance[/h2][p]Greenboard only uses 1 reroll for powers now[/p][p]Blueboard changes the lowest token into a Level 9 [/p][p]Disgused Challenge now gives the converted enemies a Level[/p][p]Game now uses seeds, so less save scamming. You still can't choose a seed though, but that may come in the future.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][p]Just alot. Alot of bug fixes. [/p]

notes.title: 1.0.13 Controller and Highscores
notes.notes:
[h2]Highscore and Longest Runs[/h2]
You can now see your best highscore for each difficulty and your furthest wave for each difficulty in the collection! When you get a new highscore or furthest wave for each it'll tell you too on the endgame screen

[h2]Basic controller Support[/h2]
Basic controller support has been added.
It's mostly just moves the mouse for you to useful positions on the screen and allows you to click with the buttons. Definately in a very basic and early state but should be good enough to play with.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
Shell -> Destroyed: [b]If there is a Juicebox reduce it's countdown by 1 otherwise[/b] Create a Juicebox
Mirage -> Merge: Copy the Merge effects of each Token in your Set
Teal Board -> At the end of each Wave transform a random Spawnable into a random Spawnable. [b]Start with a Potato on the board[/b]
Pink Board -> Now shows you how many free consume actions you have left
City Science Discovery 3 -> Your tokens on corners are [b]twice as effective[/b]
Construction Site Evolution -> Starting from Wave 7 Enemies without Vest have Vest

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed Great Oak bug that caused it to transform into another Token and then disappear
Cookie is fixed and now triggers any Token before destroying

notes.title: 1.0.12 - Sixes and Sevens
notes.notes:
[h2]Huge Balance Patch[/h2]
Large balance patch mainly around upping the power of Level 6's and 7's

Hotel -> Gone to 3 Attack
Satellite -> Gone to 5 Attack
Drums ->  REWORK: Now a Level 8 with ability: Passive: Your Level 1 Tokens Trigger again
Flamingo -> Gone to 4 Random fruit
Jockey -> Gone from level up 1 time to level up 2 times
Bison -> REWORK: Now with ability: Passive: At the end of turn Create a Broccoli. Whenever a Token is Created that can't fit buff your board by 2
Tea Ceremony -> Gone from 50% change to 75% change
Tower -> Gone to +4 Attack
Landmark -> Gone to +3 Attack
Statue -> Countdown gone from 10 to 8 Passive Attacks
Artist -> Countdown gone from 3 to 4 turns
Science Discovery 1 -> Now researches 2 extra times
Upgraded Worms -> Now only triggers level 3 and below
Bamboo Box -> REWORK: Now with ability: Passive: Your Tokens that Buff do so by an additional 1
Circus -> CHANGE: Now a Level 7 and buffs 2 instead of 3
Teapot -> REWORK: Now with ability: Passive: At the End of the Turn Create a Tea. Destroyed: Consume all Tea and Attack 2 for each
Tea -> REWORK: Now with ability: Appear: Create a Tea. Destroyed: Attack 1 (+1 for each Tea on the board)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Desert now works properly
Green board now shows upgraded Powers on reroll
Ship now exhausts straight after it is used
Creativity Science now doesn't show discoveries researched before they are researched
Bunch of text fixes
Painting, Zombie and Jockey now correctly say they only effect [b]Set[/b] Tokens (text only change)

[h2]Easier First game[/h2]
The first game you play now doesn't have any consumeables show up. This is to ease players into the game before showing them consumeables

notes.title: 1.0.9 - Clarity and Balance
notes.notes:
[h2]Clarity Changes[/h2]
Lots of Cards have had text only changes to be create more consistent naming conventions.

[h2]No Fruit on first Run[/h2]
Consumeables seemed to cause alot of difficulties for 1st time players so now the Fruit Pack only unlocks after your first run.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
Tape: Created & Destroyed: Attack 25 -> [b]Appear[/b] & Destroyed: Attack 25
Pig: Destroyed: Create 2 Broccoli -> Destroyed: Create a Broccoli or [b]Transform a Broccoli on the board into a Broccoli based dish[/b]
Baseball: Passive: When another Token is Exhausted Attack 4. 1 Use -> When another Token is Exhausted Attac 4. [b]2 Uses[/b]
Drums: Appear: Buff all your Level 1 Tokens by 10 -> Appear: Buff all your Level 1 Tokens by 10 [b]and Trigger them[/b]

notes.title: 1.0.8 Logs and Speed boosts
notes.notes:
[h2]Logs[/h2]
You can now press the handy little button next to the eyes to open up a log. 
Still in a fairly early stage, may not always log in the correct order, and some edge cases may not be logged correctly.
But for general play may be useful to show all the crazy shenanigans that can happen in a turn.

[h2]Interactive market[/h2]
Now when you press hide in the Market you can press your tokens, enemies or your powers on the side of the screen. So if you forget what something does just hide the market and tap it before you make your choice.

[h2]Game Speed[/h2]
There are now x5 and x10 game speed. Just in case you really need to go fast! 
P.S. If you start your game and it's really fast just double check your settings. 

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Home and Creativity pack descriptions have been changed to correspond with the current terminology of the game

notes.title: 1.0.7 - Flashes and Saves
notes.notes:
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
Enemies flashing when they get hit is back
Fixed Mirage bug
Fixed cloudsave bug on Mac (now cloudsave should work)

notes.title: 1.0.6 - Bandages and Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
Happy Hour: Whenever a Token [b]Creates[/b] a Consumeable, Create a Beer (new)
Wrestler: The first time one of your Set Tokens Appears each Turn, [b]Exhaust[/b] it and Practice a Sports randomly equal to half it's Level 
Bronze Silver and Gold Medals have been reworked from the Sport Science Pack

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Gold Ticket now also properly gives Upgraded Tokens on the first 2 waves as well
Teal Board now guarantees Dishes 
Teal Board now says "At the end of the Wave transform a spawnable into a random spawnable" - text only change to properly reflect what is happening
Fixed Crab and Supervillain crash
Fixed MacOS Demo not launching
Microscope now only researches Sciences you haven't completed

[h2]New Boards![/h2]
There's now classes in the game! There's 10 different colored boards to unlock. Each board has a different ability that caters to different play styles. Additionally each board guarantees a specific pack! So if you're feeling like playing a particular pack or you want to practice a particular pack you can choose it's corresponding board each run! Boards unlock just by playing the game :) 

[h2]Keyword Change[/h2]
Support has changed to Merge. This is a text only change for better clarity.

[h2]Challenge Update[/h2]
Challenges now unlock with way lower medal score requirements. Large sets of Challenges now  unlock at certain medal milestones.

[h2]Lots of Unlocks[/h2]
All these changes might mean you may log in and get HEAPS of unlocks all at once. Apologies haha, just click through em.

- Upgrades are now random Drops that increase in likelihood as you play
- Bug fixes (one day I'll fix them all)
- Achievement Fix 
- MacOS Release (MacOS is getting updates again yay)
- Only requires one win on each difficulty to unlock the next
- Review button :) I want feedback hehe
